name: Delhi Metro Sarthi App
headline: Open Source Free Alternative to Delhi Metro Sarthi App
competitorLabel: Delhi Metro Sarthi App on Google Play
description: Delhi Metro Route Planner is a free and open-source alternative for commuters who mainly need route search, station-to-station planning, fare estimates, stops, interchanges, and a fast metro map.
officialContext: The Delhi Metro Sarthi App is published by Delhi Metro Rail Corporation and includes official passenger features such as journey planning, station information, nearest station lookup, and other DMRC services.
bestFor: Planning Delhi Metro journeys without installing a closed app
Checking station-to-station routes, stops, fare estimates, and interchanges
Using a browser-based Delhi Metro map on desktop or mobile
Reviewing or improving the planner because the source code is public
limitations: It does not issue QR tickets, virtual smart cards, or official DMRC tickets
It does not replace official service alerts, safety notices, or customer support
Fare and time values are planning estimates and should be verified for critical trips
keywords: open source free alternative to Delhi Metro Sarthi App, Delhi Metro Sarthi App alternative, free Delhi Metro route planner, open source Delhi Metro map

name: DMRC Momentum 2.0
headline: Open Source Free Alternative to DMRC Momentum 2.0
description: Delhi Metro Route Planner is a free open-source option for users searching for a lighter DMRC Momentum 2.0 alternative focused on metro route planning, station search, fares, stops, and interchanges.
officialContext: DMRC Momentum 2.0 has been referenced as an earlier name for the Delhi Metro Sarthi app experience. The official app is still the place for official ticketing and account-based passenger services.
bestFor: Finding a quick route without signing into an account
Comparing route options by stops or interchanges
Sharing a selected Delhi Metro route from the web
Using an Apache-2.0 licensed codebase that developers can inspect
limitations: It is independent and is not affiliated with Delhi Metro Rail Corporation
It does not provide official account, wallet, virtual-card, or ticketing flows
Operational changes can happen before third-party planners are updated
keywords: open source free alternative to DMRC Momentum 2.0, DMRC Momentum 2.0 alternative, Delhi Metro Momentum alternative, free Delhi Metro planner

name: delhimetrorail
headline: Open Source Free Alternative to delhimetrorail
description: Delhi Metro Route Planner is a free open-source alternative for people who want an independent, map-first route planner alongside the official delhimetrorail website.
officialContext: delhimetrorail.com is the official Delhi Metro Rail Corporation website for official information, passenger notices, tenders, corporate updates, and authoritative service details.
bestFor: Opening a route planner directly instead of browsing an official portal
Checking fare estimates, stops, route distance, and interchange guidance
Using a mobile-friendly planner that can also be installed as a web app
Linking directly to station and route pages for common journeys
limitations: It is not an official DMRC website or government service
It should be used alongside official sources for notices and time-critical travel
It focuses on route planning and does not cover every official DMRC website section
keywords: open source free alternative to delhimetrorail, delhimetrorail alternative, Delhi Metro Rail website alternative, open source Delhi Metro route planner
